articles.author: Sam Ro
articles.headline: Known Worries And Unknown Unknowns
articles.summary:
There are two main types of risk.



There are well-known risks that are at least somewhat priced into the markets. They are the lingering fears that are covered regularly in the news and surfaced in surveys. As long as
articles._summary: There are well-known risks that are at least somewhat priced into the markets. They are the lingering fears that are covered regularly in the news and surfaced in surveys. As long as new developments related to these risks aren’t much worse than what’s in the range of likely outcomes, markets can handle bad news relatively well. A bunch of firms recently conducted surveys asking people what they’re worried about.
articles._zh_headline: 已知的担忧和未知的未知
articles._zh_summary: 一些众所周知的风险至少在一定程度上已被市场消化。它们是新闻中经常报道并在调查中出现的挥之不去的恐惧。只要与这些风险相关的新事态发展并不比可能的结果严重多少，市场就能相对较好地应对坏消息。许多公司最近进行了调查，询问人们担心什么。

articles._summary: Tesla (NASDAQ: TSLA ) stock will be in focus this week as the electric vehicle giant reports its financial results. The shares have fallen nearly 25% to around $380 after peaking at almost $500 in December last year. Tesla’s business is doing relatively well even as its stock remains in a bear market. Its recently released delivery numbers showed that it returned to growth in the second quarter. The company delivered 480,126 vehicles in the quarter after producing 451,758 vehicles.
articles._zh_headline: 特斯拉股票成为焦点，因为它在盈利前扩大了德国产量
articles._zh_summary: 特斯拉（纳斯达克股票代码：TSLA）股票本周将成为焦点，因为这家电动汽车巨头将公布其财务业绩。自去年 12 月达到近 500 美元的峰值后，该股已下跌近 25% 至 380 美元左右。尽管特斯拉的股票仍处于熊市，但其业务表现相对较好。其最近公布的交付数据显示，第二季度恢复增长。该公司本季度生产了 451,758 辆汽车，交付了 480,126 辆汽车。

articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: Intel Stock Forms an Alarming Pattern as Earnings Loom
articles.summary: Intel stock has formed a double-top pattern pointing to more downside as its earnings loom on Thursday this week
articles._summary: Intel is still one of the best-performing companies in the United States this year. It has jumped by 150% since January and by 320% in the last 12 months, with its valuation soaring to over $477 billion. Intel is also benefiting from the ongoing AI agent growth, which has led to a surge in demand for CPUs . The most recent results showed that its revenue jumped by 7% to $13.6 billion, while its gross margin rose to 39.4%. It also reduced its R&D and MG&A costs by 8%.
articles._zh_headline: 随着盈利的临近，英特尔股票形成令人担忧的格局
articles._zh_summary: 英特尔仍然是今年美国表现最好的公司之一。自 1 月份以来，该公司股价上涨了 150%，过去 12 个月上涨了 320%，估值飙升至超过 4770 亿美元。英特尔还受益于 AI 代理的持续增长，这导致 CPU 需求激增。最新业绩显示，其收入增长 7%，达到 136 亿美元，毛利率升至 39.4%。它还将研发和管理与管理成本降低了 8%。
